text:
Before: a chicken burger (~200 kcal bun, ~250 kcal patty, ~80 kcal mayo, plus veg; roughly 600 kcal and 280 g), a cola (~350 ml, ~150 kcal), a fruit salad (~200 g, ~90 kcal), 6 sushi pieces (~180 g, ~300 kcal), pickled ginger (~20 g, ~10 kcal) and wasabi (~10 g, ~10 kcal).

After: most of the burger bun remains, apparently the top and part of the bottom, with some lettuce. The patty seems eaten, but it is hard to tell. The cola, fruit and sushi are all gone, and so is the ginger. Some wasabi remains.

Burger eaten: the patty (~250 kcal), mayo, veg and maybe some of the bun (~50 kcal), so about 330 kcal and ~150 g.

Total: 330 (burger) + 150 (cola) + 90 (fruit) + 300 (sushi) + 10 (ginger) + 5 (wasabi) = ~885 kcal.

Mass: 150 (burger) + 350 (cola) + 200 (fruit) + 180 (sushi) + 20 (ginger) + 5 (wasabi) = ~905 g.

{"kcal": 880, "mass_g": 900}
